# Mindspan

> Mindspan is a specialist neurology clinic focused on memory loss, Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment (MCI) and dementia. Board-certified neurologists see patients in person in Danvers, Massachusetts (Boston's North Shore) and San Jose, California (South Bay), with first visits typically within 2-3 weeks (the typical specialist wait elsewhere is 12+ months). Mindspan accepts Medicare assignment and many health plans.

Clinical services are provided by Mindspan Medical PC (Massachusetts), Mindspan Medical CT, P.C. (Connecticut) and Mindspan Medical America PA.

## Clinics

- [Danvers, MA clinic](https://mindspan.co/locations/danvers): Mindspan, 99 Conifer Hill Drive, Danvers, MA 01923. Phone (978) 850-3914. Hours Monday-Friday, 9am-6pm ET. Legal entity Mindspan Medical PC, NPI 1659264646, accepts Medicare assignment. Neurologist: Dr. Timothy R. Kelliher, MD.
- [San Jose, CA clinic (Bay Area)](https://mindspan.co/locations/bay-area): Mindspan, 2520 Samaritan Dr, Suite 201B, San Jose, CA 95124. Phone (669) 291-2202. Hours Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm PT. Legal entity Mindspan Medical America PA, NPI 1912820614, accepts Medicare assignment. Neurologist: Dr. Noor Sachdev, MD.

Mindspan has no other in-person clinics. The New York address in the site footer (169 Madison Ave, Suite 90030, New York, NY 10016) is a mailing address. The main phone line, (978) 850-3914, is answered 9am-9pm ET / 6am-6pm PT.

## Clinicians

- Dr. Timothy R. Kelliher, MD - Founding Neurologist (Danvers clinic). Board-certified neurologist, MGH fellowship-trained, affiliated with Beverly Hospital and Addison Gilbert Hospital. More than three decades of clinical experience on Boston's North Shore.
- Dr. Noor Sachdev, MD - Lead Neurologist (San Jose clinic). Board-certified in neurology and vascular neurology, Columbia fellowship-trained in clinical neurophysiology, affiliated with Good Samaritan Hospital (San Jose) and El Camino Health.
- Dr. Naveen Reddy, MD - Clinical Director. Neurologist and implementation scientist focused on Alzheimer's diagnostics and anti-amyloid therapies, trained at UC San Diego and UCSF.

## Conditions Treated

- Alzheimer's disease
- Mild cognitive impairment (MCI)
- Lewy body dementia
- Vascular dementia
- Frontotemporal dementia (FTD)
- Memory loss and cognitive decline
- Neuropathy and other neurological conditions evaluated as part of the cognitive workup

## Service Area

- In-person: Danvers, Massachusetts (Boston's North Shore) and San Jose, California (South Bay)

## Insurance

Mindspan accepts Medicare assignment and many health plans. Mindspan Medical PC (Danvers, MA) and Mindspan Medical America PA (San Jose, CA) both accept Medicare assignment. Patients with qualifying dementia diagnoses on Original Medicare may also be eligible for the CMS GUIDE Model program, which Mindspan participates in.
